baseline.tail:
stop        Pause the timer / unload the LaunchAgent.
  status      Show schedule state, the installed generation (Linux) and
              the last 5 log entries.
  drift       Compare the running deployment with the installed generation
              (Linux): exit 0 current, 1 drift (a container off the
              generation's image, or not running), 2 security drift (no
              generation recorded, or the quadlets declare :53 off
              loopback), 3 not checked (an install under way, no quadlets
              to read). Reports only; nothing is re-rendered.
  run         Run a health check now (also called by the timer).
  observe     Print the observations as TSV (read-only: no log, no action).
  tick        One controller pass: observe, decide (lib/policy.sh) and act
              with acknowledged recovery (lib/recovery.sh). --shadow records
              the decision in a separate shadow state and never acts.
  route-start Before Unbound starts: demote a persisted onion route to the
              exit (active installs only). Run by <root>/route-start from
              the Unbound quadlet, the macOS agent and the macOS installer.
  logs        Print the rolling log (one line per run).
  failures    List failure dumps. Add --last to print the most recent.

Logs:
  Linux: $XDG_STATE_HOME/nice-dns-health or ~/.local/state/nice-dns-health/
  macOS: ~/Library/Logs/nice-dns-health/

What it checks (lib/health.sh; Pi-hole is 127.0.0.1 on Linux and
172.31.240.250 on macOS):
  runtime        the runtime CLI answers; pi-hole, unbound and
                 tor-{haproxy|socat} are running
  dns-owner      the host resolves through nice-dns (Linux: resolv.conf
                 names only 127.0.0.1; macOS: every enabled network service
                 and scutil's resolver #1 use 172.31.240.250)
  install-drift  Linux: an install generation is recorded and the installed
                 quadlets declare :53 on loopback only (else
                 install-security-drift, logged at err once a day)
  local-service  pi.hole has an A record (FTL alive)
  filtering      doubleclick.net is sinkholed to 0.0.0.0
  local-cache    Pi-hole answers cloudflare.com (may be cached; not upstream)
  route:<id>     each route in routes/providers.tsv answers an authenticated
                 probe; chain-resolves fails when none does
Results are healthy, unhealthy or indeterminate (could not be observed).
